title: Use the Timeline View
description: View and manage notes chronologically with the timeline

steps.title: Open Timeline View
steps.description: Click the timeline icon in the sidebar or press Ctrl+T

steps.title: Timeline Interface
steps.description: The timeline shows notes with date properties on a chronological axis. Future dates appear to the right, past to the left.

steps.title: Add Date Property
steps.description: Open a note and add a 'dueDate' or 'scheduledDate' property

steps.title: Set Due Date
steps.description: Enter 'dueDate' as key, '=' as operator, and a future date (YYYY-MM-DD)

steps.title: Enter Date Value
steps.description: Type tomorrow's date in YYYY-MM-DD format

steps.title: Event Appears on Timeline
steps.description: Return to timeline view and verify the note appears at the correct date
